policies.defaultBehavior: Clawix delete affordances prefer archive or trash with visible recovery state
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot bypass host recovery UI for user-created data
policies.approvalPolicy: ordinary scoped approval for recoverable delete; exact human approval for stronger action

policies.defaultBehavior: purge is separate from ordinary UI delete and cannot be agent-executed
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot perform irreversible purge through Clawix
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval plus recovery-window expiry

policies.defaultBehavior: host migrations and repair actions preserve launch, chat, and repair state
policies.actorPolicy: host repair actions are approval-gated when they delete, move, externally mutate, or submit reports
policies.approvalPolicy: required for risky repair, deletion, movement, report submission, and large backup overrides

policies.defaultBehavior: host import UI must stage or merge; overwrite requires snapshot and conflict report
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot choose overwrite without user-visible conflict evidence

policies.defaultBehavior: Clawix exposes export and repair context without trapping state in host UI
policies.actorPolicy: export can be initiated under scoped read permission
policies.approvalPolicy: private envelope or external submission requires explicit approval

policies.defaultBehavior: Clawix consumes framework sync plans, conflict reports, and handoff receipts before destructive apply
policies.actorPolicy: remote or delegated action cannot launder authority through a Clawix client
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval for destructive conflict resolution

policies.defaultBehavior: agent-visible Clawix actions preserve framework scope, audit, and recovery policy
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot expand permissions or purge irreversibly from host UI
policies.approvalPolicy: host approval for sensitive or destructive grants

policies.defaultBehavior: Clawix presents provider archive, trash, restore, cancel, or unarchive options before hard delete when available
policies.actorPolicy: connector control plane and signed host approval must both pass before runtime
policies.approvalPolicy: host approval required for destructive provider operations

policies.defaultBehavior: Clawix must label provider hard delete as irreversible external action
policies.actorPolicy: agents cannot execute provider hard delete without exact human approval and eligible framework policy
policies.approvalPolicy: exact human approval, signed-host receipt, provider receipt, local snapshot/export evidence where possible, and EXTERNAL PENDING live evidence until proved

durable host and framework storage surfaces expose delete/archive/snapshot candidates
host database migrations and cache cleanup
host transcript delete and purge paths
